comment:
REG_INT_BTP - Bank File to Authority Payments File v1
  Converted from SSIS package: REG_INT_BTP.dtsx
  Orchestrates bank transaction processing with data corrections, validations, and matching.

LoadTransactionData.comment: Load sample bank transactions into DuckDB for processing

parameters.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as loaded FROM transactions

LoadReferenceData.comment: Load authority reference tables for matching (aurtmast, auwbmast, auinmast, auanmast, auglmast)

parameters.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as loaded FROM ref_rates

Phase1_Corrections.comment:
PHASE 1: Initial corrections
  - Set Line_Status based on particulars validity
  - Fix debtors replace space
  - Fix rates/water category
  - Set particulars to upper-first-lower-remaining
  - Set initial line status and valid flags
  - Set transaction code

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET lineStatus = CASE WHEN particulars IN ('rates','water','parking','debtors','animal','general') THEN 'unchecked' ELSE 'Invalid Particulars' END WHERE valid = 0 AND lineStatus IN ('unchecked','Invalid Particulars')

Phase1_ValidateParticulars.comment: Validate all transactions against ParticularsValidation rules workflow

Phase2_SetCodes.comment: PHASE 2: Set Particulars_Code based on category and initial status values

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET particularsCode = CASE WHEN particulars = 'rates' THEN 1 WHEN particulars = 'water' THEN 2 WHEN particulars = 'debtors' THEN 3 WHEN particulars = 'parking' THEN 4 WHEN particulars = 'animal' THEN 5 WHEN particulars = 'general' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END WHERE extracted = 0 AND particulars IS NOT NULL

Phase2_CheckManualReceipts.comment: Validate manual receipts - set Valid=1 and Line_Status='Manual Receipt'

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET lineStatus = 'Manual Receipt', valid = 1 WHERE manualReceipt = 1 AND valid = 0

Phase3_ParallelValidation.comment: PHASE 3: Parallel validation chains for each particulars category

ValidateRates.comment: Check rates assessment number - ISNUMERIC, no dots, max 7 chars

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET lineStatus = CASE WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(code, '^[0-9]+$') AND code NOT LIKE '%.%' AND LENGTH(code) <= 7 THEN 'unchecked' ELSE 'Invalid Assessment No.' END WHERE particulars = 'rates' AND valid = 0 AND extracted = 0

FlagInvalidRates.comment: Mark rates with invalid assessment numbers

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET valid = 0, extracted = 0 WHERE particulars = 'rates' AND lineStatus = 'Invalid Assessment No.'

ValidateParking.comment: Check parking infringement number - ISNUMERIC, no dots, max 7 chars

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET lineStatus = CASE WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(code, '^[0-9]+$') AND code NOT LIKE '%.%' AND LENGTH(code) <= 7 THEN 'unchecked' ELSE 'Invalid Infringement No.' END WHERE particulars = 'parking' AND valid = 0 AND extracted = 0

FlagInvalidParking.comment: Mark parking with invalid infringement numbers

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET valid = 0, extracted = 0 WHERE particulars = 'parking' AND lineStatus = 'Invalid Infringement No.'

ValidateWater.comment: Check water assessment number - ISNUMERIC, no dots, max 7 chars

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET lineStatus = CASE WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(code, '^[0-9]+$') AND code NOT LIKE '%.%' AND LENGTH(code) <= 7 THEN 'unchecked' ELSE 'Invalid Assessment No.' END WHERE particulars = 'water' AND valid = 0 AND extracted = 0

FlagInvalidWater.comment: Mark water with invalid assessment numbers

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET valid = 0, extracted = 0 WHERE particulars = 'water' AND lineStatus = 'Invalid Assessment No.'

ValidateAnimal.comment: Check animal number - ISNUMERIC, no dots, max 7 chars

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET lineStatus = CASE WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(code, '^[0-9]+$') AND code NOT LIKE '%.%' AND LENGTH(code) <= 7 THEN 'unchecked' ELSE 'Invalid Animal Number' END WHERE particulars = 'animal' AND valid = 0 AND extracted = 0
UPDATE transactions SET valid = 0, extracted = 0 WHERE particulars = 'animal' AND lineStatus = 'Invalid Animal Number'

ValidateGeneralLedger.comment: Check general ledger code - ISNUMERIC, no dots, max 4 chars

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET lineStatus = CASE WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(code, '^[0-9]+$') AND code NOT LIKE '%.%' AND LENGTH(code) <= 4 THEN 'unchecked' ELSE 'Invalid Ledger No.' END WHERE particulars = 'general' AND valid = 0 AND extracted = 0

ZeroPadLedger.comment: Zero-pad valid ledger codes to 4 digits

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET code = LPAD(code, 4, '0') WHERE particulars = 'general' AND valid = 1 AND extracted = 0 AND manualReceipt = 0

Phase4_SMPrime.comment: PHASE 4: SM Prime special case - Flag transactions with code 7218 as invalid

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET lineStatus = 'Invalid Assessment No.', valid = 0, extracted = 0 WHERE code = '7218' AND extracted = 0

Phase4_AutoCorrections.comment: Apply auto-corrections from reference table - match transactions against authority data

parameters.sql: SELECT t.id, t.particulars, t.code, t.amount, r.ass_num FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN ref_rates r ON TRY_CAST(t.code AS INTEGER) = r.ass_num WHERE t.valid = 0 AND t.extracted = 0 AND REGEXP_MATCHES(t.code, '^[0-9]+$')

Phase5_WarningFlags.comment: PHASE 5: Set warning flags for special bank accounts, codes, and Poli entries

parameters.sql: UPDATE transactions SET warningFlag = 1 WHERE sourceAccountNumber = '12-3236-0907227-00' OR code IN ('7888','27211.37','6521','69782','9091','8864') OR code = 'multiple'

Phase5_ValidateWarnings.comment: Validate warning flags against WarningFlags rules workflow

Phase6_Matching.comment: PHASE 6: Match transactions against authority reference data

parameters.sql: SELECT t.id, t.particulars, t.code, t.lineStatus, t.valid, t.amount, t.warningFlag, CASE WHEN r.ass_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'Matched' ELSE 'No Match' END as matchStatus FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN ref_rates r ON TRY_CAST(t.code AS INTEGER) = r.ass_num WHERE t.extracted = 0 ORDER BY t.particulars, t.id
UPDATE transactions SET valid = 1, lineStatus = 'Valid' WHERE extracted = 0 AND lineStatus = 'unchecked' AND REGEXP_MATCHES(code, '^[0-9]+$')

Phase7_FinalSummary.comment: Generate final processing summary by particulars category

parameters.sql: SELECT particulars, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN valid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid, SUM(CASE WHEN valid = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as invalid, SUM(CASE WHEN warningFlag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as warnings, SUM(amount) as totalAmount FROM transactions GROUP BY particulars ORDER BY total DESC
